invariants.accepted_with_wrong_reason: an accepted candidate carries a reason other than accepted
invariants.commit_at_or_after_deadline: Eq. 9 (4): t_commit >= D, or D is NaN (expired candidate)
invariants.commit_of_cancelled_candidate: Eq. 9 (1): a candidate of a closed job (REFRESH / end of job) or an explicitly cancelled candidate is committed (late completion of a cancelled job)
invariants.commit_of_invalid_plan: Eq. 9 (2): a non-finite or kinematically implausible plan is committed
invariants.commit_of_non_newer_version: Eq. 9 (3): the committed version is not newer than the latest commit (older observation, or same observation not deeper; duplicate release)
invariants.commit_record_mismatch: runtime target: the step record's commit block disagrees with the commit decision
invariants.commit_with_margin_at_or_below_delta: Eq. 9 (5): M(t_commit - t_k) <= delta at commit
invariants.committed_versions_not_increasing: committed versions of a sequence do not strictly increase
invariants.deadline_not_eq3: runtime target: the released candidate's deadline is not t_k + H of its lease (Eq. 3)
invariants.fallback_with_valid_commit: runtime target: full-brake fallback while the latest commit is still valid
invariants.gate_runtime_out_of_sync: runtime target: the runtime's latest commit and the gate's latest version differ
invariants.spurious_rejection: an admissible candidate (all five checks pass) is rejected
invariants.tracked_at_or_after_deadline: runtime target: the watchdog lets the controller track a plan at t >= D
invariants.tracked_not_latest_commit: runtime target: the tracked plan is not the latest commit
invariants.wrong_rejection_reason: the logged reason is not the first failing check in the order of Sec. 2.4

notes: Every sequence is run against both targets; the generator and its probabilities are in "generator".

runtime target: V4Runtime has no single-candidate cancellation (REFRESH or the end of a job closes the whole job, V3Runtime._end_job); cancel events are counted as cancel_events_not_applicable and only closed jobs are cancelled there.

runtime target: the lease of every candidate is scripted (ScriptedLeasePolicy.compute_lease); validity, D = t_k + H, the kinematic check, the margin check, the gate, job closing and the watchdog are deployed code.

margin oracle: |M - delta| <= 1e-9 is ambiguous and judged neither way; coverage.ambiguous_margin counts the offers whose decision the margin alone would make (an earlier failing check decides the others).

A share p_deadline_tie of the offers with a finite D is committed exactly at t_commit = D, the Eq. 9 (4) boundary; coverage.deadline_tie counts those that the deadline check decides (a gate accepting t_commit <= D fails commit_at_or_after_deadline).
